source.title: KPII: new results and open problems.

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document identifier 2120846.

Failure mode: metadata_only plus network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetching. The sandboxed shell could not resolve zbmath.org, and the page reader did not expose a readable zbMATH record body. Exact-work metadata recovered from the local zbMATH harvest and independent bibliographic pages identifies the same source as A. K. Pogrebkov, 'KPII: new results and open problems.', published in Nonlinear physics: theory and experiment, II (Gallipoli, 2002), World Scientific, 2003, pages 108-117.

Bounded recovery used exact-title searches for the title alone, the title plus PDF, the title plus Pogrebkov, the title plus World Scientific, the ISBNs 9789812382702 and 9789812704467, and candidate World Scientific DOI patterns. Candidate pages inspected or represented in search results were rejected because they were publication lists, reference lists, tables of contents, bookstore pages, paid ebook pages, or metadata-only DOI hints rather than a readable exact-work PDF or HTML source containing the problem statements.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the article's open-problem statements was recovered.

The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, bibliographic pages, tables of contents, abstracts, citation-only pages, search snippets, or related papers. The run therefore remains in needs_review with accepted empty.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/2120846.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
